rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically removing or depositing cargo from a vehicle.

example.english: The workers started to unload as soon as the truck reached the dock.
example.traditional: 貨車到咗碼頭，工人即刻開始卸貨。
example.jyutping: fo3 ce1 dou3 zo2 maa5 tau4 gung1 jan4 zik1 hak1 hoi1 ci2 se3 fo3

rows.note: Use this for expressing pent-up feelings, especially when someone vents them at another person.

example.english: You shouldn't unload your anger on me.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 lo2 ngo5 lai4 faat3 sit3

rows.note: Use this specifically when removing the bullets or charge from a gun rather than handling ordinary cargo or feelings.

example.english: Remember to unload the gun after firing.
example.jyutping: se6 gik1 jyun4 gei3 dak1 teoi3 zi2 daan2
